column1: # GBA cartridges whose save type or extra hardware can't be read from the ROM's library strings.
# Derived from mGBA's src/gba/overrides.c (65db8569, Copyright (c) 2013-2015 Jeffrey Pfau,
# Mozilla Public License 2.0: https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/). One cartridge per line:
# game code (0xAC) | save: none sram sram64 flash64 flash128 eeprom eeprom512, or - (detect) | hardware
# Read by gba-core (backup.rs, rtc.rs) at boot and by gb5.py build. Add a line for a game that saves wrong.
